export function isTaskFile(fileName, extensions) {
    if (fileName.startsWith('.') || fileName.endsWith('.d.ts')) {
        return false;
    }
    return extensions.has(extname(fileName));
}
export function taskNameFromFileName(fileName) {
    return basename(fileName, extname(fileName));
}
/** The mtime query keeps a re-read after an edit from serving a cached module. */
export async function importTaskDefinition(filePath, mtimeMs) {
    const url = pathToFileURL(filePath);
    url.searchParams.set('mtime', String(Math.trunc(mtimeMs)));
    const module = await import(__rewriteRelativeImportExtension(url.href));
    return module.default;
}

任务运行器只允许 idGeneratorToken；服务须在 provider 注册后即可用，不依赖 boot/start。

## Resolving services

Migration callbacks and seed `run` also receive `container`, a `ServiceResolver` exposing `has(token)`, `resolve(token)`, and `resolveIfCreated(token)`. Application task runners wrap the application container with a token-identity allowlist; only `idGeneratorToken` from `@nocobase/app-server/id-generator` is currently allowed. Use `container.resolve(idGeneratorToken).generateString()` for string IDs or `.generate()` for numeric IDs. Disallowed tokens return false from `has` and throw from both resolution methods. The wrapper reuses application singleton instances and exposes no registration methods. Startup and CLI share the application factory in `server/app.ts`, which registers `IdGeneratorProvider`; CLI database commands call the application factory discovered from `rootDir/server/app.ts` (or `.js` in compiled applications), register its providers without booting or starting them, and use its database manager and migration contributions. They dispose the application and runtime scope after execution, including failure and cancellation. Keep the factory free of startup side effects; CLI does not call `app.start()` or trigger autoRun. Services must therefore be usable after provider registration; do not depend on later boot/start hooks. Direct application and database runners accept a `container` option. Without a source container, an allowed token returns false from `has`, undefined from `resolveIfCreated`, and a missing-service error from `resolve`. Standalone `@nocobase/db` runners accept an owner-supplied resolver; the application allowlist is enforced by `app-server`, including direct `createAppMigrator` and `createAppSeeder` calls.

### [轻微][指引缺失] 应用 provider 未守卫可选插件 token，最小运行时启动崩溃

**相关对象**：`app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development`、`@nocobase/service-provider`（评审时 0.0.2-beta.1）

services-and-jobs 示例在 register 中直接 resolve(databaseManagerToken)；authorizationToken 由插件提供，未装配该插件时 ServiceContainer.resolve 抛 is not registered，app-server 逻辑测试在 LibraryProvider.boot 失败。

**影响**：应用 provider 无法在未装配授权插件的最小运行时启动，测试红灯。

**建议改动**：在应用开发指引中说明：对插件提供的可选 token 先 container.has() 守卫再 resolve；或明确此类 provider 必须容错。

**验收标准**：app-server provider 测试通过

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/service-provider/dist/container.js:20–27` — resolve 在 token 未注册时抛 Service "..." is not registered；has 用于可选性判断。
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/services-and-jobs.md:29–43` — provider register 中解析 token 并注册单例；把 provider 加进 providers/index。
- `artifacts/verify-3.log:793–793` — LibraryProvider.boot 解析未注册的 authorizationToken，app-server 测试报 Service not registered。
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/migrations.md:136–138` — 任务运行器只允许 idGeneratorToken；服务须在 provider 注册后即可用，不依赖 boot/start。

app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication/SKILL.md:140–140E23

用户名 3–30 个字母/数字/下划线/点，邮箱合法，均小写存储。

Before the first seed run, set `users.initialAdmin.username`, `users.initialAdmin.email` and `users.initialAdmin.password` in application configuration to customize the bootstrap account. Omitting the entire node preserves `nocobase` / `admin@nocobase.com` / `admin123`; an explicit node requires a nonempty password and defaults the username to `nocobase` and the email to `admin@nocobase.com`. Usernames contain 3–30 letters, digits, underscores or dots, emails must be valid addresses, and both are stored lowercase. Initialization only runs when the user table is empty, hashes the password and grants the newly created account root permission through the authorization plugin. After initialization, configuration changes do not reset accounts or rerun the recorded seeds. The root permission seed selects the administrator by the same configured username. Use the user administration service for subsequent account changes. Do not edit historical seeds or add a competing administrator seed.

轻微易用性改进上游未复核原评审：已解决
F3 · records 选择只接受字符串 id，整数主键定向共享 500

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/authorization · @nocobase/db · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db

⌄

parseRecordSelection 要求所有 id 为非空字符串；仓储过滤器不会把字符串 id 转成 integer，materials 用 increments 整数主键时 `id in ("2")` 触发 INVALID_FILTER 并 500。

实际影响
管理员按 UI 选择单条记录共享会失败；须改集合主键类型才能使用定向共享。
建议改法
在 authorization/sharing Skill 中明确 records 选择只接受字符串 id 并建议业务集合用字符串 uuid 主键；框架侧可考虑对可安全转换的整数 id 做归一化，或在路由层返回 4xx 而非 500。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
整数自增主键集合上使用 selection.records([id])
应有能力 / 行为
共享创建成功
实际观察
RepositoryError: Filter value is invalid for Field "id" of type "integer"（500）
应用绕行与代价
主键改 string uuid
改进后的验收标准
定向共享/撤销/限制均通过
评审时证据 · 冻结快照 5 条
packages/@nocobase/authorization/dist/core/selection.js:9–24E1

parseRecordSelection 只接受非空字符串 id 的 records 选择；other 选择被拒绝。

export function parseRecordSelection(value) {
    if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)) {
        const type = Reflect.get(value, 'type');
        if (type === 'all')
            return selection.all();
        const ids = Reflect.get(value, 'ids');
        if (type === 'records' &&
            Array.isArray(ids) &&
            ids.every((id) => typeof id === 'string' && id !== ''))
            return selection.records(ids);
        const key = Reflect.get(value, 'key');
        if (type === 'recordAccess' && typeof key === 'string' && key)
            return selection.recordAccess(key, Reflect.get(value, 'params'));
    }
    throw new TypeError('Invalid record selection');
}
packages/@nocobase/db/dist/src/repository/repository.js:1150–1160E14

过滤器值类型不符时抛 INVALID_FILTER，例如 integer 字段收到字符串。

            case 'datetimeTz':
                return ((value === null && ['$eq', '$ne'].includes(operator)) ||
                    validDateLiteral(field.type, value));
            default:
                return false;
        }
    })();
    if (!valid) {
        invalid('INVALID_FILTER', `Filter value is invalid for Field "${field.name}" of type "${field.type}".`, { field: field.name, path: [...path, 'value'] });
    }
}

迁移示例 collection.increments('id') 使用整数自增主键。

const migration: MigrationDefinition = defineMigration({
  name: '202609020001_create_orders',

  async up({ builder }) {
    await builder.createCollection('orders', (collection) => {
      collection.increments('id');
      collection.string('orderNo', { length: 64, nullable: false });
      collection.string('status', { length: 32, nullable: false });
      collection.datetime('createdAt', { nullable: false });
      collection.unique('orderNo');
      collection.index('status');

上游 Issue 草稿 · Markdown
### [轻微][易用性改进] records 选择只接受字符串 id，整数主键定向共享 500

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/authorization`（评审时 0.1.0-beta.10）、`@nocobase/db`（评审时 1.0.0-beta.16）、`app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db`

parseRecordSelection 要求所有 id 为非空字符串；仓储过滤器不会把字符串 id 转成 integer，materials 用 increments 整数主键时 `id in ("2")` 触发 INVALID_FILTER 并 500。

**影响**：管理员按 UI 选择单条记录共享会失败；须改集合主键类型才能使用定向共享。

**建议改动**：在 authorization/sharing Skill 中明确 records 选择只接受字符串 id 并建议业务集合用字符串 uuid 主键；框架侧可考虑对可安全转换的整数 id 做归一化，或在路由层返回 4xx 而非 500。

**验收标准**：定向共享/撤销/限制均通过

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/authorization/dist/core/selection.js:9–24` — parseRecordSelection 只接受非空字符串 id 的 records 选择；other 选择被拒绝。
- `packages/@nocobase/db/dist/src/repository/repository.js:1150–1160` — 过滤器值类型不符时抛 INVALID_FILTER，例如 integer 字段收到字符串。
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:86–96` — 迁移示例 collection.increments('id') 使用整数自增主键。
- `artifacts/retro.json:1–1` — retro 记录两个已解决 blocker：用户名过短 422 与整数主键定向共享 500。
- `artifacts/agent-history/agent-repair-2.jsonl/part-0037.txt:2347–2349` — 原始日志错误信号分诊（agent-repair-2.jsonl）：201 {"data":{"key":"share-draft-to-yier","resource":{"type":"composite","id":"library.materials"},"actions":[{"action":"view","scopeKey":"materials","selection":{"type":"records","ids":["2"]}}],"title":"临时共享草稿","subjects

> 来源：nb3-factory 独立搭建评审（口径 v2，源 Run 36498925234 / attempt 1）。尚未复核最新上游源码。
实现者过程与运行背景 · 4 个过程问题 / 4 条建议 · 不自动归为框架问题

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

从空模板补齐内部资料库业务：materials 集合迁移与仅 3 条种子文档、资料员/阅读者两个权限集、发布/保密记录访问与阅读者限制规则、materials HTTP 接口与客户端页面，管理员共享 API 与临时授权。已在全新 SQLite 上跑通迁移与全部种子，并用真实登录账号端到端验证：甲可写自己的文档，乙只读已发布且非保密文档，机密文档对乙封锁，甲的机密权限不受影响，管理员共享后可撤销且乙刷新即失效，停用乙后其在线会话立即 401。同时修复了两处导致验收失败的真实缺陷（用户名过短、整数主键记录共享 500），并让负责人列显示账号名而非 UUID。 修复本轮验证回归：应用种子相对导入改用 .ts 以适配原生种子加载，LibraryProvider 对缺失的授权服务做存在性判断。

问题 01 · 运行时验证

演示账号用户名过短，Better Auth 拒绝登录

本任务已处理

阅读者账号 `yi`（2 个字符）凭用户名登录返回 422 {"message":"Username is too short","code":"USERNAME_TOO_SHORT"}；仅邮箱登录可用，导致按账号清单以用户名登录的验收失败。

原因（实现者自述）
@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication 默认注册 Better Auth username 插件，其 minUsernameLength 默认值为 3；种子里的 `yi` 不满足，服务端在注册的用户名策略处直接拒绝。
处理方式
把演示阅读者账号重命名为 `yier`，并同步修改账号种子、权限集分配种子、限制规则种子中的用户名与邮箱引用；`jia` 为 3 字符本就合法。重新登录验证 200。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：server console + 种子文件
问题 02 · 授权共享

对单条记录共享时后端 500（记录选择要求字符串主键）

本任务已处理

通过 /api/authz/sharing-rules 用 {type:'records', ids:["<id>"]} 定向共享一条文档时，请求返回 500 Internal Server Error，日志为 RepositoryError: Filter value is invalid for Field "id" of type "integer"。

原因（实现者自述）
记录选择的 ids 在授权层被强制要求为字符串；而 materials 使用 increments 整数自增主键，仓库过滤真实类型为 integer，id in ("2") 触发类型校验失败。
处理方式
按 NocoBase 约定把 materials 主键改成字符串 uuid（string('id',{length:36}).primary()），种子与创建接口用 crypto.randomUUID() 生成 id，服务端 id 校验与客户端类型同步为 string。重新验证定向共享、撤销、机密封锁均正常。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：server error log + 迁移/种子/路由
问题 03 · 数据库种子

应用种子从原生加载的 TS 里相对导入 .js 模块失败

本任务已处理

app-server 测试启动全新 Default 时 Database seeds failed for connection "main": Cannot find module ".../database/seed-data/permission-sets.js" imported from ".../database/main/seeds/202609290002_library_permission_sets.ts"，3 个用例失败。

原因（实现者自述）
@nocobase/db 的种子/迁移加载器用原生 Node import() 直接执行源码 .ts；Node 24 的类型剥离不会把相对说明符里的 .js 解析到同名 .ts，deploy/tsx 之外没有这个回退，所以 server 源码里惯用的 .js 后缀在种子链路失效。
处理方式
把 database/ 下相对的 .js 导入改为 .ts（database/main/seeds/202609290002、202609290003 与 database/seed-data/permission-sets）。tsconfig.server.json 已启用 allowImportingTsExtensions + rewriteRelativeImportExtensions，tsc 编译时把 .ts 重写成 .js，已用 scoped emit 验证产物 import 指向 .js。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：app-server.test.ts 失败堆栈
问题 04 · 服务提供者

应用 provider 无条件解析插件 token，隔离运行时测试启动崩溃

本任务已处理

app server > registers application-owned providers and routes from the runtime 失败：Error: Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered，位置 server/providers/library.ts:26 boot()。

原因（实现者自述）
LibraryProvider 作为应用级 service provider 注册进 server/providers/index.ts，boot() 里无条件 resolve authorizationToken；该测试用空插件列表组装 runtime，授权插件（及其 AuthorizationProvider）不存在，于是 boot 抛错。
处理方式
boot() 先 container.has(authorizationToken) 判断，缺失时直接返回；真实应用始终注册授权插件，模型照常注册，隔离测试则跳过而不是让启动失败。
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：app-server.test.ts 失败堆栈

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · 文档

授权记录选择强制字符串 id 未在 Skill 中说明

需人工判断

@nocobase/authorization 的 parseRecordSelection 要求 type:'records' 的 ids 全部为非空字符串，且 app-plugin-authorization 的仓储过滤不会把字符串 id 转成整数；但授权 Skill 的分享规则与仓储路由参考没有提示这一点，也没有说明整数自增主键会在定向共享时 500。

建议改动

在 nocobase-app-plugin-authorization 的 sharing-rules/repository-routes 参考中加入一节：records 选择只接受字符串 id；新建业务集合默认用字符串 uuid 主键并给出迁移与 createOne 生成 id 的示例。

来源：authz 运行时错误

建议 02 · 模板/种子

演示账号用户名需满足 Better Auth 最小长度

可自动化

Better Auth username 插件默认 minUsernameLength=3，种子或文档若使用 1-2 个字符的演示用户名，会在登录时以 USERNAME_TOO_SHORT 失败，而创建阶段不会有任何提示。

建议改动

在账号创建/演示账号相关参考中明确最小用户名长度，或让种子工具在写入前校验长度并按工厂约束报错。

来源：登录失败 422

建议 03 · 前端规范

加载数据的 effect 触发 react-hooks/set-state-in-effect

需人工判断

在 useEffect 中直接调用一个会同步 setState 的 load() 函数会命中 eslint 的 react-hooks/set-state-in-effect 错误；本仓库模板页多用 mock 数据，没有现成的加载模式可借鉴。

建议改动

在应用开发的前端参考里给出一个符合该规则的请求模式：effect 内使用 api.request(...).then/.catch 回调设置状态并带 active 取消标志，而不是在 effect 中调用同步 setState 的函数。

来源：eslint --max-warnings 0

建议 04 · 模板/数据库

原生加载的种子/迁移需用 .ts 后缀导入应用源码

可自动化

pnpm dev 经 tsx 运行会回退 .js→.ts，但 app-server 的 standalone 测试与 @nocobase/db 加载器用原生 Node import() 执行源码，不会回退；文档中的 seed-data 示例统一写 .js，照抄后测试才在 3 个用例上暴露 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND。

建议改动

在 nocobase-db / app-plugin-authorization 的 code-and-seeds 参考中说明：跨文件导入应用源码时在源文件写 .ts 后缀，依赖 allowImportingTsExtensions + rewriteRelativeImportExtensions 由 tsc 产出 .js；或让测试运行器为动态种子加载注册 tsx 解析器。

来源：ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND

E1 · packages/@nocobase/authorization/dist/core/selection.js:9–24

parseRecordSelection 只接受非空字符串 id 的 records 选择；other 选择被拒绝。

export function parseRecordSelection(value) {
    if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)) {
        const type = Reflect.get(value, 'type');
        if (type === 'all')
            return selection.all();
        const ids = Reflect.get(value, 'ids');
        if (type === 'records' &&
            Array.isArray(ids) &&
            ids.every((id) => typeof id === 'string' && id !== ''))
            return selection.records(ids);
        const key = Reflect.get(value, 'key');
        if (type === 'recordAccess' && typeof key === 'string' && key)
            return selection.recordAccess(key, Reflect.get(value, 'params'));
    }
    throw new TypeError('Invalid record selection');
}

E2 · packages/@nocobase/authorization/dist/plugins/internal/rules.js:4–20

validateRule 校验 key/resource/action，并拒绝非 allowAll 类型的 all 选择。

export function validateRule(rule, kind) {
    if (!rule.key)
        throw new TypeError('A rule needs a key');
    if (!rule.resource.type || !rule.resource.id)
        throw new TypeError(`Rule ${rule.key} needs a resource`);
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const action of rule.actions) {
        if (!action.action)
            throw new TypeError(`Rule ${rule.key} has an unnamed action`);
        const id = JSON.stringify([action.action, action.scopeKey ?? null]);
        if (seen.has(id))
            throw new TypeError(`Rule ${rule.key} repeats ${action.action}`);
        seen.add(id);
        const selection = parseRecordSelection(action.selection);
        if (selection.type === 'all' && !kind.allowAll)
            throw new TypeError(`A ${kind.id} rule cannot select all records`);
    }

    async authorize(request, grantsService, constraintsService) {

        if ('effect' in resolved)
            return resolved;
        const resource = resolved;
        const params = request.params;
        if (!databaseCollectionFieldsKnown(resource, params?.fields)) {
            return this.deny('UNKNOWN_DATABASE_FIELD', `One or more requested fields are not registered for ${resourceId}`);
        }
        const resolvedGrants = await grantsService.resolve({
            principal: request.principal,
            subjects: request.subjects,
            resource: { type: 'database.collection', id: resourceId },
            action: request.action,
        });
        const grants = params?.operation
            ? resolvedGrants.filter((grant) => grant.origin?.resource.id === params.operation?.resource &&
                grant.origin?.action === params.operation?.action)
            : resolvedGrants;
        const configs = grants.flatMap(toDatabaseGrant);
        if (configs.length === 0) {
            return this.deny('NO_OBJECT_PERMISSION', `No database grant allows ${resourceId}.${request.action}`);
        }
        const fields = resolveDatabaseFields(configs, request.action);
        if (!databaseFieldsAllowed(params?.fields, fields)) {
            return this.deny('FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED', 'One or more input, output, filter, sort, or group fields are not allowed');

## Implement in this order

1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable composite, page and data scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).

        const id = crypto.randomUUID();

    async update(key, rule) {
        await this.connection().transaction(async (connection) => {
            const current = await connection.query

                .executeTakeFirst();

        });

## Development workflow

1. State the invariant positively, for example "this team may access only non-confidential projects". Define who it applies to and whether it covers one operation or every path to a collection.
2. Use a rule on a composite, with `scopeKey`, for an operation-specific limit. For a limit across every business branch, create a rule on the `database.collection` with its CRUD actions; the settings page offers declared business data scopes, and collection-wide invariants can be provisioned through the service.
3. Register a suitable record access and save the complete rule. Apply the restriction directly to a user as well when it must remain after that person's team membership is removed.
4. Bind policies on all protected reads and writes. For relation targets, declare relation record access explicitly; a standalone collection restriction is not inherited by nested relation writes.
5. Verify the excluded row stays inaccessible after adding broad sharing and another permission set, across each protected operation, and that unrelated actors keep their intended access.

默认访问为已持有动作的身份添加基线，不授予动作，限制规则仍收窄。

Default access adds a shared record baseline for every identity that already holds an action. It does not grant the action, page access or additional fields. A baseline combines with permission-set data scopes and sharing, and restriction rules still narrow the result, so choose it as an intentional minimum range rather than a fallback for identities without a scope of their own.

Read the installed `nocobase-app-plugin-authorization` Skill first for composite resources, data scopes, fields, server policy enforcement and inherited subjects. The package README at `node_modules/@nocobase/app-plugin-authz-default-access/README.md` is the complete reference for the service, the HTTP routes and the exports; this Skill covers how to use them.

For a department-scoped baseline, read the application development Skill's `references/organization/permission-design.md` first. Its core works with permission sets alone, and its optional default-access section explains why a global default suits a department scope only when everyone holding the action belongs to a department.

## Development workflow

1. Identify which records every holder of a particular operation should receive by default. A read baseline can be broad while edit remains preparer-only; do not copy read defaults into write operations.
2. Confirm the composite, action and data scope exist and that the scope's grants target the intended collection. Reuse an applicable record access or define one through the main authorization Skill.
3. Save one rule per resource under a stable `key`; a second rule on the same resource is rejected, so extend the existing rule instead. A rule lists every action and data scope it widens; updating it replaces the whole rule, and deleting it removes the baseline, not the permission-set action.
4. Verify a holder receives the baseline, a person without the action remains denied, and restrictions still remove excluded rows. Also verify an explicit narrow data scope is not unexpectedly broadened by a permissive default.

    if (fileName.startsWith('.') || fileName.endsWith('.d.ts')) {
        return false;
    }
    return extensions.has(extname(fileName));
}
export function taskNameFromFileName(fileName) {
    return basename(fileName, extname(fileName));
}
/** The mtime query keeps a re-read after an edit from serving a cached module. */
export async function importTaskDefinition(filePath, mtimeMs) {
    const url = pathToFileURL(filePath);
    url.searchParams.set('mtime', String(Math.trunc(mtimeMs)));
    const module = await import(__rewriteRelativeImportExtension(url.href));
    return module.default;
}

## Resolving services

Migration callbacks and seed `run` also receive `container`, a `ServiceResolver` exposing `has(token)`, `resolve(token)`, and `resolveIfCreated(token)`. Application task runners wrap the application container with a token-identity allowlist; only `idGeneratorToken` from `@nocobase/app-server/id-generator` is currently allowed. Use `container.resolve(idGeneratorToken).generateString()` for string IDs or `.generate()` for numeric IDs. Disallowed tokens return false from `has` and throw from both resolution methods. The wrapper reuses application singleton instances and exposes no registration methods. Startup and CLI share the application factory in `server/app.ts`, which registers `IdGeneratorProvider`; CLI database commands call the application factory discovered from `rootDir/server/app.ts` (or `.js` in compiled applications), register its providers without booting or starting them, and use its database manager and migration contributions. They dispose the application and runtime scope after execution, including failure and cancellation. Keep the factory free of startup side effects; CLI does not call `app.start()` or trigger autoRun. Services must therefore be usable after provider registration; do not depend on later boot/start hooks. Direct application and database runners accept a `container` option. Without a source container, an allowed token returns false from `has`, undefined from `resolveIfCreated`, and a missing-service error from `resolve`. Standalone `@nocobase/db` runners accept an owner-supplied resolver; the application allowlist is enforced by `app-server`, including direct `createAppMigrator` and `createAppSeeder` calls.

Before the first seed run, set `users.initialAdmin.username`, `users.initialAdmin.email` and `users.initialAdmin.password` in application configuration to customize the bootstrap account. Omitting the entire node preserves `nocobase` / `admin@nocobase.com` / `admin123`; an explicit node requires a nonempty password and defaults the username to `nocobase` and the email to `admin@nocobase.com`. Usernames contain 3–30 letters, digits, underscores or dots, emails must be valid addresses, and both are stored lowercase. Initialization only runs when the user table is empty, hashes the password and grants the newly created account root permission through the authorization plugin. After initialization, configuration changes do not reset accounts or rerun the recorded seeds. The root permission seed selects the administrator by the same configured username. Use the user administration service for subsequent account changes. Do not edit historical seeds or add a competing administrator seed.

  public readonly name: string = 'app/order-provider';

  public override register(): void {
    this.app.container.singleton(orderServiceToken, () => {
      const database = this.app.container.resolve(databaseManagerToken);
      return createOrderService(database);
    });
  }
}

This Skill decides which API to reach for, where the code belongs, and the boundaries the types cannot express.\n\n## Where the code lives\n\n```text\nserver/config/database.ts          connections and the default connection\nconfig.yml                         per-environment overrides and credentials (gitignored)\ndatabase/<connection>/migrations   schema history for that connection\ndatabase/<connection>/seeds        install data for that connection\ndatabase/<connection>/collections  resolved Collection artifacts\nserver/routes/, server/providers   runtime reads and writes\n```\n\n`<connection>` is a connection name from `server/config/database.ts`, so the default connection's migrations are in `database/main/migrations/`. What was delivered

业务场景与交付说明

只读与维护边界

阅读者乙仅能查看公开且非保密资料，直接编辑请求返回 403；资料员甲可编辑自己负责的草稿并保持原值回填。

单条临时共享与撤销

管理员通过共享规则只对“私有草稿”单条记录授予 View，乙可见正文但无编辑权；删除规则并刷新后立即不可见。

保密资料隔离

即使对乙开放保密资料 C 的普通共享，乙列表与接口均无 C，直接编辑 403；甲对 C 的读取不受影响。

账号停用即时生效

停用乙后其原有会话刷新即跳转登录页并返回 401，甲的账号与三份资料不受影响。

→

原始验收要求

乙可以阅读 P 但不能编辑；甲可以维护自己的资料。

实际操作

  1. 管理员后台将阅读者乙密码重置为已知值并在独立会话登录乙
  2. 乙打开文档库列表，仅看到“公开文档”P；打开 P 详情读取到正文；对 P 记录直接发 PATCH 编辑请求被拒绝
  3. 资料员甲登录后打开文档库，打开“私有草稿”编辑表单，原值回填正确（标题 私有草稿 / 正文 这是一篇尚未发布的草稿…），修改正文并保存，列表更新时间变化，重新打开详情看到新正文

观察结果

  1. 乙列表只含 P（1 行），无编辑/删除按钮；P 详情正文可见（b01-reader-reads-P.png）
  2. 乙对 P 的 PATCH 返回 403 FORBIDDEN，证明乙只读不能编辑
  3. 甲编辑 D 原值回填正确，保存后提示 Document updated.，详情显示新正文（b01-librarian-edited-draft.png）

原始验收要求

停用乙后，乙原有会话无法继续访问；甲的账号和资料不受影响。

实际操作

  1. 乙在自身会话中登录并确认身份为“阅读者乙”，停留在文档库
  2. 管理员在 设置-用户管理 中对“阅读者乙”执行 Disable account 并确认（提示 will be signed out from every device immediately）
  3. 乙原有会话重新加载 /main/materials，被跳转到登录页；其会话请求 API 返回 401 UNAUTHORIZED
  4. 资料员甲重新登录，文档库仍显示 P/D/C 三份资料，可正常编辑

观察结果

  1. 管理员侧乙状态变为 Disabled（b05-admin-disabled-reader.png）
  2. 乙刷新后跳转登录页（b05-reader-session-blocked.png），API 返回 401 UNAUTHORIZED
  3. 甲仍可登录且列表含全部三份资料（b05-librarian-unaffected.png）
